responsibility: Declares the shared interface and core data structures for GCC’s legacy reload implementation, including reload kinds, per-reload descriptors, insn-chain state, and the APIs that connect find_reloads logic in reload.cc with whole-function reload processing in reload1.cc and caller-save support. It is the contract header for old reload, exposing helper queries, elimination services, reload creation/substitution routines, and debugging hooks to the rest of the RTL backend.
same_name_distinction: This is the shared interface/header for old reload, defining reload descriptors, enums, insn-chain state, and declarations spanning reload.cc, reload1.cc, and caller-save support. The same-stem source gcc/reload.cc is specifically the insn-scanning and reload-requirement analysis implementation.
